    Răspunsul modului AI pentru "THE SORT SYSTEM LTD" uk company vat

    The specific VAT number for THE SORT SYSTEM LTD is not publicly indexed or listed in free company registries, but you can find its official Companies House overview under company number 14374685. 
    Company Details
    • Company Name: THE SORT SYSTEM LTD 
    • Company Number: 14374685 
    • Status: Active (with active proposal to strike off) 
    • Registered Address: 8 Filey Waye, Ruislip, England, HA4 9AU 
    • Incorporation Date: 24 September 2022 
    How to Find or Verify Their VAT Number
    • Check Invoices: UK businesses usually display their Value Added Tax (VAT) number on official invoices, receipts, or their business website. 
    • Verify Online: If you have obtained their VAT number from an invoice, you can confirm its validity using the official Check a UK VAT number service on GOV.UK (note that the government portal does not allow name-only VAT searches). 
    If you have an invoice or document containing a potential VAT number for this company, let me know and I can guide you on how to verify it further.
